Gemini and Vertex AI power the recognition, analysis, and comparison pipeline.
Compares prices across multiple supermarkets in Brazil in real time.
Displays results in an organized format to help consumers maximize grocery savings.

overview.en: PUMA developed the AI Creator app using AI Hypercomputer, Vertex AI, and Gemini running on NVIDIA H100 GPUs to democratize digital kit design. The app allowed Manchester City fans to design a real jersey that would be worn on the pitch — a Premier League first. During the 11-day live phase, the system reduced image generation time from 60 to 17 seconds per four HD images, requiring only 306 of the originally planned 600 GPUs. The campaign generated 54,000 registrations from 206 countries, 180,000 unique kits, and 1.7 million ratings.

11 天活動期間吸引來自 206 個國家的 54,000 名用戶註冊。
創建了 180,000 件獨特球衣設計，收到 170 萬個評分。
每四張高解析度圖像的生成時間從 60 秒縮短至 17 秒。
實際使用 306 個 GPU（原計劃 600 個），基礎設施效率提升 49%。

overview.en: T&C Surf Design, a Hawaiian surf brand with over 50 years of history, uses Gemini in Google Docs to write radio copy for its marketing campaigns. The AI-assisted copywriting helps the team efficiently produce broadcast advertising scripts that convey the authentic spirit and culture of their decades-long surf heritage, reaching a wider audience without extensive creative production resources.
overview.zh: 擁有超過 50 年歷史的夏威夷衝浪品牌 T&C Surf Design，運用 Gemini in Docs 為其行銷活動撰寫廣播文案。AI 輔助的文案撰寫幫助團隊高效製作傳達真實衝浪文化精神的廣播廣告腳本，在不需要大量創意製作資源的情況下觸及更廣泛的受眾。

en: Uses Gemini in Docs to write radio advertisement copy efficiently.
Helps a 50+ year legacy surf brand communicate its culture and heritage to a wider audience.
Enables a small team to produce broadcast-quality scripts without dedicated copywriting staff.
zh: 運用 Gemini in Docs 高效撰寫廣播廣告文案。
幫助一個有 50 多年傳承的衝浪品牌向更廣泛的受眾傳達其文化與歷史。
讓小型團隊無需專屬文案人員也能製作廣播級腳本。

summary.en: UNFPA uses Google Workspace with Gemini as a 'superpowered writing assistant' to help staff craft precise, tonally correct communications.
summary.zh: UNFPA 運用 Google Workspace 與 Gemini 作為「超強寫作助理」，協助員工撰寫精確、語調適當的對外溝通。

overview.en: The United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA) has adopted Google Workspace with Gemini as an intelligent writing assistant across its global operations. The tool helps staff — from country directors drafting high-stakes emails to government officials, to non-English speakers who need to express their message precisely — to get the right tone, formality, and clarity in their written communications, enhancing the organization's effectiveness in delivering its global mission.
overview.zh: 聯合國人口基金（UNFPA）在全球業務中採用 Google Workspace 與 Gemini 作為智慧寫作助理。該工具幫助員工——從需要向政府官員起草重要電子郵件的國家代表，到需要精確表達訊息的非英語母語者——在書面溝通中達到正確的語調、正式程度和清晰度，提升組織履行全球使命的效能。

en: Google Workspace with Gemini described as 'a superpowered writing assistant' by UNFPA.
Helps country directors calibrate tone and formality in emails to government officials.
Supports non-English speaking staff to communicate their message precisely in English.
Enhances overall organizational communication effectiveness across global field offices.
zh: UNFPA 稱 Google Workspace 與 Gemini 為「超強寫作助理」。
協助國家代表在發送給政府官員的電子郵件中校準語調和正式程度。
支援非英語母語員工以英語精確表達訊息。
提升全球各地辦事處的整體組織溝通效能。

overview.en: Wisconsin Cheese Mart, a specialty cheese retailer, uses Gemini in Google Docs to write product descriptions for its online store. The AI-assisted copywriting allows the team to efficiently produce informative, compelling product listings for its growing e-commerce customer base — without taking time away from the personalized, hands-on in-store experience that defines the brand.
overview.zh: 特色起司零售商 Wisconsin Cheese Mart 運用 Gemini in Docs 為其線上商店撰寫商品描述。AI 輔助文案撰寫讓團隊能高效為快速成長的電商顧客群製作資訊豐富、吸引人的商品清單，同時不佔用定義品牌的個人化實體店體驗時間。

en: Uses Gemini in Docs to write online product descriptions for specialty cheese products.
Enables efficient content production to serve a growing e-commerce customer base.
Frees staff to focus on the personalized in-store experience rather than digital copywriting.
zh: 運用 Gemini in Docs 為特色起司商品撰寫線上商品描述。
實現高效內容生產，服務快速成長的電商顧客群。
讓員工得以專注於個人化的實體店體驗，而非數位文案撰寫。
